name: Rameron Pigeon
rangeDescription: Ethiopia to eastern democratic republic of the congo, tanzania, and south africa; western angola
description: Big, dark pigeon with a gray head, and bright yellow feet, bill, and eye ring. Plain in flight.

name: Black-cheeked Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Southern mexico (veracruz, chiapas) to western colombia and western ecuador
description: Medium-sized woodpecker of humid evergreen forest and edge in tropical lowlands. Less numerous than larger and more conspicuous Golden-fronted Woodpecker, which often occurs in the same areas.

name: Fulvous-breasted Flatbill
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia and far western venezuela to western bolivia
description: Scarce, inconspicuous flycatcher of Andean cloud forest. It has olive upperparts, tawny breast, yellow belly, gray eyering, and brown patches in wings.

name: Comoro White-eye
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island (montane heath of mount karthala)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the yellow underparts and the narrow white spectacles around the eyes.

name: Timor Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Timor (eastern lesser sundas)
description: Small and stout forest-dweller that hops and buzzes about in the canopy like a large, active insect. Note male’s iridescent dark blue back, red chest patch, and black line extending partway down the white belly.

name: Santa Marta Antbird
rangeDescription: Northern colombia (sierra nevada de santa marta)
description: Slender, long-tailed antbird restricted to the lower slopes of Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. It is heavily streaked on the head, breast, and back and has a tawny belly and rump.

name: Chatham Islands Shag
rangeDescription: Chatham islands
description: Fairly large black-and-white shag with pink feet and orange facial skin that becomes purple during the breeding season. Adults have a striking appearance, with a black head and a clean white chin, neck, and belly.

name: Zanzibar Boubou
rangeDescription: Southern somalia, kenya, and northeastern tanzania; zanzibar
description: A heavily built black-and-white bushshrike. The upperparts are cleanly black and the underparts are white with a pinkish tinge.

name: Pied Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Bismarck archipelago, including admiralty islands
description: A large silver and black cuckoo-dove that shows obvious contrast between the light silver chest, belly, neck, and head and the much darker gray wings and tail. More confined to primary foothill forest than other cuckoo-doves in its range, which are smaller and less robust, lacking the distinctive silver-gray color scheme of Pied.

name: Sjöstedt's Owlet
rangeDescription: Lowlands of southwestern cameroon to gabon, northern congo, and northwestern democratic republic of the congo
description: A small owlet of lowland and foothill forest interior with intricate barring patterns over most of its body, including the buff-and-black underparts, the gray-and-white head, the rufous back, and the black-and-white wings and tail. Primarily nocturnal, but sometimes calls around first light.

name: Makira Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Makira (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Male is light powder-gray with darker wing feathers and tail and a dark patch in front of the eye. Female is powder-gray above and vivid reddish below.

name: Taiwan Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, strikingly patterned songbird endemic to Taiwan, where fairly common. Brown above, white below, with white supercilium, black mask, and heavy black spots on the breast.

name: Narrow-tailed Starling
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to northern angola, democratic republic of the congo, and western uganda; bioko
description: A starling with a piercing gaze that is not easily forgotten, often found in flocks high in fruiting trees in forests, primarily in the lowlands but sometimes high in the mountains. Males are a glossy purple-black all over with a long, pointed tail, and females are a duller gray-black all over with a short tail.

name: Dark-throated Seedeater
rangeDescription: Southeastern bolivia (southeastern tarija), southwestern brazil (western mato grosso do sul, southern rio grande do sul), paraguay, northern argentina (salta eastward to corrientes, southward to tucumán, northern córdoba and northern buenos aires), and westerm uruguay; non-breeding to northern and eastern bolivia and central and southern brazil (eastward to minas gerais, and southward to rio grande do sul)
description: A small finchlike bird with a short and stubby bill. Males are a striking combination of gray, black and a rich cinnamon color.

name: Spotted Greenbul
rangeDescription: Liberia to southern cameroon, gabon, democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, and northwestern tanzania
description: A distinctive rainforest greenbul with olive-brown upperparts, pale underparts, white spots on the wings, and white outer tail feathers. Found in the canopy of humid forest at low and middle elevations, usually in restless flocks of 5-15 individuals, but occasionally gathers by the dozens.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Varied Solitaire
rangeDescription: Highlands of far eastern panama (darién) and adjacent northwestern colombia
description: Medium-sized thrush with extremely limited range at the border of Panama and Colombia. Unlikely to be mistaken—gray head and underparts with black face and brown back are unique.

name: Scarlet-hooded Barbet
rangeDescription: Humid eastern peru, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Brightly colored, yellow-billed barbet. Found in dense secondary growth, especially in bamboo and around water.

name: Dusky Starfrontlet
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia (antioquia)
description: Rare hummingbird known only from a few locations in the northern half of Colombia’s western Andes. Large and long billed with iridescent green belly and rump.

name: Spot-throated Flameback
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (balabac, palawan, and calamian islands)
description: A large woodpecker of wooded habitats on Palawan and neighboring islands. Whitish below with dark scaling and golden-olive above with a diffuse reddish mark on the back and a finely spotted, pale cream-colored throat.

name: Rio Branco Antbird
rangeDescription: Far northern brazil (along rio branco) and adjacent guyana
description: A slender, long-tailed bird of dense gallery forests and river islands in northern Brazil and extreme southwestern Guyana. Male is mostly black with tail feathers tipped white and with white scalloping on wings.
